result.description: A fictional low-power desktop display designed for reading-heavy workflows, archival review, and ambient-note dashboards. The Siltbrush uses a 27-inch monochrome E-Ink panel with a 1200 x 825 resolution, USB-C video input, and a rear tilt stand for stationary desk setups. It emphasizes eye comfort and near-zero static power draw over motion performance, making it intentionally unlike gaming or storage hardware.
result.title: Novara Siltbrush 27-Inch E-Ink Monitor
